songs.title: Huwag Ka Nang Mangako
songs.lrcText:
[00:12.50] Huwag ka nang mangako
[00:16.20] Na hindi na mauulit...
[00:20.10] Dahil alam ko namang
[00:23.40] Madali kang maakit...

songs.title: Harana
songs.lrcText:
[00:10.00] Umuulan nanaman...
[00:14.20] At hindi ka man lang nagparamdam...
[00:18.50] Kailan kaya muling
[00:22.10] Makakapiling ka?
